project.title: Cross-Unit Food Waste Reduction and Revenue Optimization Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a company-wide food waste reduction program that improves margins and sales without impacting guest satisfaction.
deliverables: Baseline analysis of current food waste and revenue impact across units
Standardized food waste tracking and reporting process
Revised purchasing and inventory guidelines aligned to waste targets
Menu and sales playbook to promote high-margin, low-waste items
Training package for managers and frontline staff
Executive dashboard with KPIs and monthly review cadence
constraints: Program must be designed and piloted within 30 days
No increase in overall operating costs in the first 6 months
Must comply with food safety and local waste disposal regulations
Changes cannot reduce guest satisfaction scores below current baseline
Purchasing changes must respect existing key supplier contracts
Reporting must be feasible with current systems and staff capacity

risks.risk: Operational teams resist new tracking routines and guidelines.
risks.mitigation: Co-design processes with unit managers, keep forms simple, and link KPIs to existing review meetings.

risks.risk: Purchasing changes cause stock-outs or quality issues.
risks.mitigation: Pilot new purchasing rules in limited units, monitor closely, and maintain safety stock thresholds.

risks.risk: Sales push for low-waste items conflicts with guest preferences.
risks.mitigation: Test offers via limited-time promotions, gather feedback, and adjust menu positioning accordingly.

risks.risk: Data quality is insufficient to measure waste reduction impact.
risks.mitigation: Provide clear tracking templates, short training, and spot checks during the first month.

risks.risk: Suppliers are unable or unwilling to adapt delivery patterns.
risks.mitigation: Engage key suppliers early, negotiate flexible order quantities, and identify backup suppliers if needed.

themes.why_relevant: Clear metrics are needed to track progress and justify changes to purchasing and operations.
Procurement decisions directly affect waste levels, costs, and supplier relationships.
Sales and menu design can steer demand toward items that generate less waste and higher margins.
Managers and staff must adopt new routines without disrupting service quality.
Leadership needs visibility and decision points to scale or adjust the program.

backlog.task: Define company-wide food waste reduction targets and success KPIs
definition_of_done: Written target document approved by executive management
KPIs defined with baseline values and target ranges
Targets communicated to department manager and sales manager

backlog.task: Map current waste-related processes in pilot units
definition_of_done: Process map created for at least three representative units
Pain points and quick wins identified and documented
Validated with unit managers and head chef representative

backlog.task: Design standardized food waste tracking template and routine
definition_of_done: Tracking template created and reviewed with purchaser and head chef
Daily and weekly routines defined and documented
Template tested in one pilot unit for at least three days

backlog.task: Review and adjust purchasing rules to reduce over-ordering
definition_of_done: High-waste categories identified from baseline analysis
Revised order frequency and minimum order quantities proposed
Changes validated against supplier contracts and approved by CEO

backlog.task: Negotiate with key suppliers for more flexible delivery options
definition_of_done: Top 5 suppliers for perishable goods identified
Meetings held and notes recorded for each supplier
At least two suppliers agree to more flexible quantities or schedules

backlog.task: Develop menu and sales recommendations to promote low-waste items
definition_of_done: List of low-waste, high-margin items created with head chef input
Promotional concepts and upsell scripts drafted
Recommendations shared with executive management for sign-off

backlog.task: Create staff training materials on waste tracking and sales behaviors
definition_of_done: Short training deck and one-page quick reference guide created
Includes examples for kitchen, service, and sales staff
Reviewed and approved by chief executive officer

backlog.task: Pilot the waste reduction program in selected units
definition_of_done: At least three units enrolled with clear start date
Staff trained and tracking routines started
First two weeks of data collected and logged

backlog.task: Design executive dashboard for monitoring waste and revenue impact
definition_of_done: Key charts and metrics defined and documented
Data sources and update frequency agreed with department manager
Dashboard mock-up reviewed with leadership team

backlog.task: Define communication plan for internal and external messaging
definition_of_done: Internal announcement draft prepared for all units
Optional external messaging outline created for marketing
Plan approved by chief executive officer

backlog.task: Collect and analyze pilot results to refine the program
definition_of_done: Pilot data consolidated for waste and revenue metrics
Key insights and issues summarized in a short report
Recommendations for scale-up agreed with CEO and purchaser

backlog.task: Align sales incentives with waste reduction objectives
definition_of_done: Current incentive scheme reviewed and documented
Proposed adjustments drafted to reward low-waste behaviors
Proposal validated with executive management and finance

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on program scope, targets, and pilot units before execution starts.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff announcement by chief executive officer outlining the initiative.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm company-wide waste reduction target percentage and timeline.
Select the initial set of pilot units and agree on pilot start date.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalize the waste tracking process and supporting tools.
threads_plan.trigger: Department manager shares first draft of tracking template and SOP.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard waste tracking template and reporting cadence.
Agree on which KPIs will be visible in the executive dashboard.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align purchasing rules and supplier arrangements with waste targets.
threads_plan.trigger: Purchaser posts analysis of high-waste categories and proposed purchasing changes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve revised purchasing rules for pilot units.
Prioritize which suppliers to approach for flexible delivery terms.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define menu, sales tactics, and communication plan for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Sales manager shares draft menu recommendations and sales playbook.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Finalize the list of priority low-waste items to promote in the pilot.
Agree on internal communication and incentive adjustments for sales teams.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review early pilot results and decide on adjustments or scale-up.
threads_plan.trigger: Department manager posts first consolidated pilot results from baseline tracker.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm or adjust waste reduction targets based on pilot results.
Finalize dashboard views for broader rollout based on pilot learnings.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each role posts status, blockers, and next steps on their tasks.
Weekly pilot metrics review post summarizing key KPIs from the baseline tracker and dashboard spec.
Pre-pilot go/no-go checklist review using the pilot readiness checklist for each new unit.
Post-pilot retrospective thread capturing what worked, what failed, and proposed process tweaks.
